verdict.rationale: Customer.io publishes an OpenAPI spec at docs.customer.io/openapi.json and documents its Track, Pipelines and App APIs. It also provides a Postman collection for running requests, so runnable examples are available, but through an external tool rather than a confirmed in-browser interactive reference. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs API explorer or 'try it' console, runnable code examples embedded in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
